_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): complete admin-ready CRUD vertical slice — model, schema, router, service, tests. List endpoint is paginated + searchable + sortable (?page=&page_size=&search=&sort=), status codes 201/200/204/404. package_dir must match the project package name (stack-webapp sets it automatically).
name: feature-crud
description: Admin-ready FastAPI CRUD: model, schema, router, service, tests. Paginated searchable list envelope (?page=&search=&sort=) + 201/204/404 codes.

variables.name: package_dir
variables.description: Project package name (must match the scaffold's package, e.g. 'app' or 'my_api')

notes: After applying: 1) register the router in the app (app.include_router(router)), 2) make sure the model is imported so SQLAlchemy creates its table (Base.metadata.create_all runs at app import — the model uses the scaffold's shared Base), 3) adapt the db session import ({{ package_dir }}.database.get_db) to your project, 4) run the generated tests. The list endpoint's {items,total,page,page_size} envelope + ?search=&sort= match the frontend comp-crud-page admin template.
